open.why: maintainers/maximdolphin/cluster-nodes/node-5b2dfa and node-f82aa6 both self-registered on 2026-06-14 (5h apart, same 185H/22-core/66G hardware block) reporting one MAC. Two readings, and choosing between them from the repo alone would be inference: either one machine re-registered under a fresh node id after a rebuild (probe surface over-counts by one), or a manifest was copied and one hardware block is fiction. Max owns the answer; the substrate must not guess it. Held open rather than deleted because a node.yaml is a self-report and deleting someone's self-report to make a check green is the wrong direction of repair.
